411	                         - self.__starttag_text.rfind("\n")  # noqa: E127

That split the paragraph around the comment. **Fix (`markdown/htmlparser.py`):** - The parser now keeps a list of inline tags that are open in the current paragraph. A tag is added when it opens and removed when its closing tag appears. - Elements that never have a closing tag (`img`, `source`, `br`, …) aren't added. - The list is cleared at a blank line or when a block-level raw HTML block starts. - A comment (or a declaration/processing instruction like `` or ``) at the start of a line is only treated as a standalone block when no inline tag is open. Otherwise it stays inline. - Existing behaviour is unchanged otherwise.
